svg.title: Submission Builder solution architecture
svg.desc: An editable-style architecture showing a local Next.js workspace, FastAPI, Agent Framework harness, Markdown skills, native local shell, durable run files and independent LibreOffice publication. Only model inference uses Microsoft Foundry. An optional company knowledge roadmap is explicitly marked not implemented.

text.tspan: From raw broker files to a validated workbook - with human approval.
Broker approval controls the editing workflow
Approve in a later turn -> edit a copy -> validate -> publish
First-turn publication is blocked in code; later approval is interpreted from chat.
Prompts + tool outputs over authenticated API
One trusted user / no hosted app infrastructure
Atomic JSON saves; no database or vector index
Optional company knowledge roadmap - NOT IMPLEMENTED
Curated Markdown first; add RAG only when document volume or retrieval needs justify it.
Current skills are procedural guidance, not a company knowledge index. No Blob, AI Search or vector DB is used.
TRUST BOUNDARY: Local shell is not sandboxed. Files stay local; selected document content can leave in model prompts and tool output.
